Descriptions.Two-Handed Melee: Any Hero can freely use any Two-Handed Weapon, as long as the Stat requirements are met. Attacks with Two-Handed Weapons use 2 Action Points. For some Two-Handed Weapons, you can spend 1 extra Action Point when you declare the attack to add the extra effect to the attack.
Descriptions.Two-Handed Ranged: Any Hero can freely use any Two-Handed Weapon, as long as the Stat requirements are met. Attacks with Two-Handed Weapons use 2 Action Points. For some Two-Handed Weapons, you can spend 1 extra Action Point when you declare the attack to add the extra effect to the attack.
Descriptions.Wands: Wands are usually reserved for spellcasters with high Focus, and generally have elemental Damage and effects different from regular weapons.

Cleaver.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you rolled a maximum die, add another 1d6 Damage, and you take 50% of all the attack's Damage.
Cleaver.Name: Cleaver

Club.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you rolled a 1, Single-Stun the target.
Club.MagicAlternatives: Branch, Rootclub, Femur, Antler, Carrot, Skillet, Idol
Club.Name: Club
Club.Notes: A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.

Dagger.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you rolled a 3 or a 4, add another 1d6 Damage.
Dagger.Alternatives: Kunai, Kris, Sai, Tanto, Pugio, Rondel
Dagger.Name: Dagger

Flail.Notes: Does not scale with any Stat.
Flail.Alternatives: Combat Chains, Kusarigama, Lucerne, Lantern, Anchor
Flail.Name: Flail

Hand Axe.Combo: Heal for an amount equal to your Presence.
Hand Axe.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you rolled a maximum die, apply a ~Combo~.
Hand Axe.Name: Hand Axe

Hand Hammer.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you rolled a maximum die, apply a ~Combo~.
Hand Hammer.Notes: Does not scale with any Stat.
Hand Hammer.Name: Hand Hammer

Mace.Alternatives: Light Morningstar, Pernach, Cudgel, Bludgeon, Truncheon
Mace.Name: Mace
Mace.Notes: A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.

Rapier.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you rolled all equals on d4's, and wield no other weapon or shield, apply a ~Combo~, then make a free Move Act.
Rapier.Name: Rapier

Scimitar.Special: You are more appreciated if you pronounce it as 'Skimitar'
Scimitar.EffectGreen: Your next ranged weapon attack will apply a ~Combo~ after dealing Damage.
Scimitar.Name: Scimitar

Shortsword.EffectGreen: Once per attack, you may reroll a die.
Shortsword.Alternatives: Falchion, Sabre, Scimitar, Arming Sword, Sabre, Shamshir
Shortsword.MagicAlternatives: Edge, Gladius, Sidearm, Spathion, Blade, Steel, Soulblade
Shortsword.Name: Shortsword

Sickle.Notes: The price is for a battle sickle. A normal peasant's sickle would be half the price, dealing 1 less damage.
Sickle.MagicAlternatives: Hook, Reaphook, Reaper, Hookblade, Harvester, Jawbone, Thornhook, Sica
Sickle.Name: Sickle

Whip.Combo: The attack has 6 meters range and ignores Cover.
Whip.MagicAlternatives: Scourge, Flogger, Cord, Tail, Vinelash, Tentacle, Spinewhip
Whip.Name: Whip

Battle Axe.Combo: Heal for the lowest die rolled for each ~Combo~ on the target (consumes all ~Comboes~).
Battle Axe.Effect: {CriticalStrike} for each maximum die rolled, apply a ~Combo~.
Battle Axe.Name: Battle Axe

Greatclub.Effect: {Green('Critical Strike')} if you at least one 8 and ~Combo~: Single-Stun the target.
Greatclub.MagicAlternatives: Log, Totem, Trunk, Bonecrusher, Skullbreaker, Column, Tree, Greathorn, Boulder, Giantbone, Chandelier, Statue, Anvil, Millstone, Cauldron, Greatrod, Greatstaff, Sausage, Keg, Breaker
Greatclub.Name: Greatclub
Greatclub.Notes: A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.

Greatsword.EffectGreen: All 6's rolled, together, hit another Unit within 2 meters of the target for that amount.
Greatsword.Alternatives: Claymore, Zweihander, Naginata, Broadsword, Bastard Sword
Greatsword.Upgrade: {Replacement}{A}1 {ActionPoint}: +1d6 Damage and another Unit within 2 meters of the target.
Greatsword.Notes: Hitting another Unit with the d6's is optional.
Greatsword.Name: Greatsword

Halberd.EffectGreen: +Presence Damage against Large or larger enemies.
Halberd.Alternatives: Garden Rake, Glaive, Gleaves, Bardiche, Voulge
Halberd.MagicAlternatives: Poleaxe, Fauchard, Earthsplitter, Warbrand, Fauchard, Woldo
Halberd.Name: Halberd

Heavy Mace.Effect: {CriticalStrike} for each maximum die rolled, Slam the target 1 meter in any direction.
Heavy Mace.Name: Heavy Mace

Katana.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you rolled a maximum d6, the Attack gains +1d10 Damage.
Katana.Upgrade: {Replacement}{A}1 {ActionPoint}: Gain one of the rolled dice as a Shielding.
Katana.Alternatives: Wakizashi, Longsword, Claymore, Zweihander, Naginata, Broadsword, Bastard Sword, Blade, Edge
Katana.Name: Katana

Longsword.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you rolled an 11 or a 12, add Damage equal to 10% of the target's current Health!
Longsword.Upgrade: {Replacement}{A}1 {ActionPoint}: You may reroll one of the attack's dice.
Longsword.Name: Longsword

Pickaxe.EffectGreen: Deals +1d6 Damage against Units wearing a shield or heavy armor (or both).
Pickaxe.Name: Pickaxe

Quarterstaff.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you rolled a maximum die, the next attack on you deals -50% Damage (if you're still wieleding this weapon).
Quarterstaff.Upgrade: {Replacement}{A}1 {ActionPoint}: also hits a unit near you and the target with -50% Damage.
Quarterstaff.Notes: A Quarterstaff is a wooden weapon masterfully crafted for physical combat, with correct weight and density and properly balanced; it's not a mage's walking stick!
Quarterstaff.MagicAlternatives: Shillelagh, Jo, Bo, Pole, Battlestaff, Warstaff
Quarterstaff.Name: Quarterstaff

Scythe.Upgrade: {Replacement}{A}1 {ActionPoint}: trigger the Critical Strike effect if it didn't already trigger.
Scythe.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you rolled maximum on a die, deal 1d8 Damage to all Units within 1 meter of you. This can retrigger the Critical Strike.
Scythe.Notes: The price is for a battle scythe. A normal peasant's scythe would be half the price and can't use the special effect.
Scythe.Name: Scythe

Trident.EffectGreen: If you attack at least 3 meters away from where you started your Turn, +Instinct Damage.
Trident.Name: Trident

Warhammer.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you rolled maximum on a die, Slam the target 1d8 meters away from you.
Warhammer.MagicAlternatives: Maul, Mallet, Martel, Malleus, Sledgehammer, Sledge
Warhammer.Name: Warhammer

Bow.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you rolled an 8, +1d8 Damage and apply a ~Combo~.
Bow.Upgrade: {Replacement}{A}1 {ActionPoint}: Shoot another quick arrow for 1d8 Damage that can {Green('Critically Strike')}.
Bow.MagicAlternatives: Recurve, String, Yumi, Longbow, Greatbow, Longshot
Bow.Name: Bow

Heavy Gun.Combo: Deals 50% of the Damage to all other Units within 2 meters of the main target.
Heavy Gun.Downside: After attacking, if you rolled at least one 1, the Heavy Gun jams, and must be reloaded with a 1 {A}Action Point before using it again.
Heavy Gun.Notes: Attacks with this weapon do not add any Stat to the Damage. Using the special effect consumes 2 ammo.
Heavy Gun.MagicAlternatives: Shotgun, Cannon, Rifle, Arquebus, Boomstick, Leadthrower, Roar, Blaster, Sieger
Heavy Gun.Name: Heavy Gun

Javelin.Upgrade: {Replacement}{A}1 {ActionPoint}: Also hits a Unit 1 meter behind the target for -50% Damage.
Javelin.Notes: This weapon is baseline made for throwing.
Javelin.Name: Javelin

Blowgun.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you rolled a 4, apply a ~Combo~ and choose a number about the Unit to learn the value of.
Blowgun.Notes: The normal ammunition for this is the Regular Poison Darts (full supply).
Blowgun.Name: Blowgun

Handgun.Downside: If you rolled a 1, the Handgun jams, and must be reloaded with 1 {A}Action Point before using it again.
Handgun.MagicAlternatives: Pistol, Flintlock, Pepperbox, Matchlock, Sidearm, Handcannon, Quickshot
Handgun.Notes: Handgun attacks do not scale with any Stat.
Handgun.Name: Handgun

Shuriken.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you rolled a 12, the weapon bounces to another chosen Unit within 4 meters of the target, but without the -4 Damage!
Shuriken.Upgrade: The effect applies even to the bounce attack, so it can keep bouncing as long as you keep rolling 12!
Shuriken.Alternatives: Tomahawk, Boomerang, Kunai, Glaive, Chakram, Kylie
Shuriken.Name: Shuriken

Sling.EffectGreen: Every 3rd Sling attack in Worthy Combat fires another pellet!.
Sling.Notes: The Sling attack counting carries on from Turn to Turn, but not from Combat to Combat.
Sling.Name: Sling

Elemental Wand.Effect: 1d6 instead of 1d4 if you already dealt Damage of this Type to the target this Turn.
Elemental Wand.Name: Elemental Wand

Divine Censer.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you rolled an 8, Blind the target.
Divine Censer.Name: Divine Censer
Divine Censer.Notes: A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

Arcane Symbol.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you rolled a 1 or a 2, Slam the target that many meters in any direction.
Arcane Symbol.Name: Arcane Symbol

Scourge Idol.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you rolled a 6, a 7, or an 8, apply a ~Combo~.
Scourge Idol.Name: Scourge Idol

Staff of Nature.Effect:
{CriticalStrike} if you rolled a 12, Daze the target.
{CriticalStrike} if you rolled a 1, apply a ~Combo~.
Staff of Nature.Name: Staff of Nature
